# M&L AI

> M&L AI makes AI-driven software focused on defensive cybersecurity — local-first, open source, and built to respect the people who use it. This is a static site: there is no API, no login, and no on-site AI agent.

All projects are open source under github.com/mlaify. Security reports go to security@mlaify.io (PGP key linked from /.well-known/security.txt).

## Projects

- [AttackMap](https://mlaify.io/attackmap/): Local-first, AI-assisted defensive security analysis for codebases. Maps the attack surface, traces request-to-sink data flow, scores exploitability, and writes a prioritized, evidence-grounded review. Beta; under active development, but progress may be slow until more contributors join.
- [AttackMap documentation](https://docs.mlaify.io/): Install, quickstart, CLI reference, AI review, CI, the macOS app, and the analyzer SDK.
- [grrclone](https://mlaify.io/grrclone/): A free, open-source macOS menu bar app that connects rclone remotes as Finder volumes. No licence key, no phone-home, no kernel extension, no root.
